why: The Cosmos DB card's keep: one document a minute with the account's readings from Azure Monitor (normalized RU, request units, requests and the 429s among them, data and documents, server-side latency) and one document an hour with the account's record, its containers and their time-to-live read back from the live account, and the Activity Log. Partitioned on the UTC day and written by the SQL site alone, so a reading is never written twice. The kind, the day, the moment and the three bucket keys are indexed and nothing else, so a window is a grouped query over the index. Documents expire thirty-one days after they are written, one more than the longest window (ADR: One frame for every resource).
